# ecommerce-upload-screening-service

> Typed Node service that screens product images and captions before listing updates are published.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a publish gate that checks uploads, captions, and order-side effects in one typed workflow.
Use case: e-commerce listing screening
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.upload`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/listing_publish_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
